historical_record.description: The City Planning Commission approved a conditional use authorization to construct a mixed-use development of 15 dwelling units and approximately 3,000 square feet of commercial/retail space at the ground level, providing 4 parking spaces, with conditions addressing affordability and subordination.

The City Planning Commission approved, as amended, the Planning Code Text Amendment to establish the Third Street and Oakdale Avenue Affordable Housing Special Use District at 4800 Third Street, recommending the amendment to the Board of Supervisors.

The City Planning Commission approved the Zoning Map Amendment to establish the Third Street and Oakdale Avenue Affordable Housing Special Use District at 4800 Third Street and to reclassify the Height and Bulk District from 40-X to 50-X, recommending the amendments to the Board of Supervisors.

The City Planning Commission approved the conditional use authorization to demolish a vacant commercial building and construct a four-story, 50-foot building with up to 18 units of affordable housing and approximately 2,250 square feet of ground floor retail space at 4800 Third Street.
A vacant commercial building stood at the property.
